name: com.4over4/custom-printing
title: 4OVER4
description: Custom printing from 4OVER4: business cards, flyers, banners, live prices, order on 4over4.com.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Lists every 4OVER4 print category (business cards, flyers, postcards, banners, stickers, labels, packaging, signs and more); use it when someone wants to browse what 4OVER4 prints. For one named category or product, show_products is the sibling. Takes no input. Returns the 14 shop-by groups with the categories inside each. Customer phrases: "what do you print", "show me all product categories", "where do I start".

tools.name: show_products
tools.description: Finds 4OVER4 custom print products (business cards, flyers, postcards, banners, stickers, labels, packaging and more) by words, category, budget or goal; use it when someone asks what 4OVER4 has for a print need. For a price use configure_product; for a goal with no product use recommend. All inputs are optional. Returns products with slug, name, From price, rating, 4OVER4's own photo (image_url) and page (url); use those photos, not pictures from other sites. Customer phrases: "soft touch business cards", "cheapest flyers", "signs for a real estate office".

query.description: Free words: an industry, occasion, finish, material, shape or product, e.g. "die cut stickers".

category.description: Category slug, e.g. business-cards, postcards, flyers.

angle.description: Industry, occasion, finish, material or shape paired with productType, e.g. wedding.

productType.description: Product type paired with angle, e.g. postcards.

sort.description: Result order: most reviewed, lowest From price, highest rated or newest.

maxTotal.description: Budget for the whole order in USD. An estimate that ignores volume discounts.

tools.name: find_similar_products
tools.description: Finds 4OVER4 print products like one product, in the same category and near its price; use it when someone names one product and wants alternatives to it. For products that pair with it use find_matching_print_products; for discovery from words use show_products. Requires the product slug. Returns up to 6 similar products with slug, name and From price. Customer phrases: "products like standard business cards", "cheaper options like this", "something similar to these flyers".

slug.description: Product slug, from the slug field of a show_products, recommend or find_similar_products result, e.g. standard-business-cards.

tools.name: find_matching_print_products
tools.description: Finds 4OVER4 print products that pair with one product, such as letterhead and envelopes with business cards or stickers with packaging; use it when someone asks what goes with a print product. For products like it use find_similar_products; for a whole campaign use marketing_kit. Requires the product slug. Returns the recommended pairing products with slug, name and From price. Customer phrases: "what goes with these business cards", "matching envelopes for my invitations".

slug.description: Product slug, from the slug field of a show_products, recommend or find_similar_products result, e.g. standard-business-cards.

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description: Compares two to four 4OVER4 print products side by side (price, paper, finish, turnaround, rating); use it when someone asks which print product to choose. For two finishes or papers in general use search_knowledge. Requires 2 to 4 product slugs. Returns one row per product with From price, paper, finish, turnaround, rating and reviews. Customer phrases: "premium or standard business cards", "difference between these two flyers".

slugs.description: 2 to 4 product slugs, each from the slug field of a show_products, recommend or find_similar_products result.

tools.name: recommend
tools.description: Recommends 4OVER4 print products for a business, event or goal (a new bakery, a trade show, a wedding); use it when someone describes a print need but names no product. For a named product use show_products; for several printed pieces use marketing_kit. Requires the need in the customer's words. Returns the best products or collection with slugs and From prices, or a help answer. Customer phrases: "what should I print for my dental clinic", "opening a coffee shop".

query.description: The goal, business or situation in the customer's words.

budget.description: Budget in USD, when the customer gave one.

tools.name: marketing_kit
tools.description: Builds a 4OVER4 print kit for a campaign or launch, one real product per piece (business cards, flyers, banners, signs, stickers); use it when someone plans a promotion or an opening and wants several printed pieces. For one product use show_products. Requires the goal; productTypes names the exact pieces. Returns one product per piece with slug and reason, plus a short plan. Customer phrases: "grand opening kit", "business cards, postcards and flyers for my real estate business".

goal.description: The goal or occasion, e.g. grand opening; for a set of product types, what ties them together.

productTypes.description: Product types to include, one product each, e.g. ["business cards", "postcards", "flyers"].

timeline.description: When it happens, e.g. in 3 weeks.

channels.description: Where people see it, e.g. direct mail, event booth.

tools.name: configure_product
tools.description: Prices one 4OVER4 print product live (business cards, flyers, postcards, banners, stickers or any other) for a quantity, size, paper, finish and turnaround; use it when someone asks what a print job costs or which options it has. For a quantity ladder use price_breaks; for dates use delivery_by_zip. Requires the product slug. Returns the live total and per-piece price, sizes, quantity tiers, turnarounds, options, an order link and a cart link, shown as 4OVER4's own configurator card with its photo; show that card instead of building another form. Customer phrases: "how much for 500 glossy business cards", "16pt postcards in 3 days".

slug.description: Product slug, from the slug field of a show_products, recommend or find_similar_products result, e.g. standard-business-cards. A category slug such as business-cards prices its main product.

size.description: Size in inches as width x height, e.g. 4x6 or 2x3.5; a round size is its diameter both ways plus circle, e.g. 2x2 circle.

attributes.description: Option choices: each key is an option group label and each value is a string from that group's choices in the options field of a result, e.g. {"Ink Color": "4/4", "Paper Type": "16pt Gloss Cover", "Rounded Corners": "Yes"}.

mailing.description: true prices direct mail and Every Door Direct Mail options, postage included.

tools.name: price_breaks
tools.description: Shows every quantity tier and price per piece for one 4OVER4 print product; use it when someone asks how the price changes with quantity or wants bulk pricing. For one exact configuration use configure_product. Requires the product slug. Returns each tier's total and per-piece price for the standard configuration and the best-value tier; size-priced products have no table. Customer phrases: "price breaks on postcards", "how much cheaper if I order 2500", "bulk pricing for flyers".

productSlug.description: Product slug, from the slug field of a show_products, recommend or find_similar_products result, e.g. standard-business-cards.

tools.name: delivery_by_zip
tools.description: Gives the in-hands date for one 4OVER4 print product, with an estimate for a US ZIP code when given one; use it when someone asks when their business cards, flyers, banners or other prints would arrive. For a price use configure_product; for shipping methods in general use search_knowledge. Requires the product slug; the ZIP code and quantity are optional. Returns production days, a shipping estimate and the in-hands date. Customer phrases: "when would 500 flyers arrive in 10001", "how fast can I get banners".

slug.description: Product slug, from the slug field of a show_products, recommend or find_similar_products result, e.g. standard-business-cards.

zip.description: Destination US ZIP code, exactly 5 digits, e.g. 10001.

tools.name: calculate_print_resolution
tools.description: Calculates the pixels an image needs for a 4OVER4 print at a given size and DPI; use it when someone asks whether an image is large enough to print. For bleed use calculate_print_bleed; for one product's full file setup use get_print_file_setup. Requires width and height in inches; DPI defaults to 300. Returns the pixel width and height. Customer phrases: "what pixel size for a 4x6 at 300 DPI", "is 1024x768 enough for a 5x7 print".

dpi.description: Resolution in dots per inch. Default 300.

tools.name: calculate_print_bleed
tools.description: Calculates the full file size with bleed and the safe area for a 4OVER4 print at a trim size; use it when someone asks how much bleed a print file needs. For what bleed means use search_knowledge; for a product's complete setup use get_print_file_setup. Requires trim width and height in inches; bleed defaults to 0.125 inches per side and DPI to 300. Returns the file size in inches and pixels and the safe area. Customer phrases: "how much bleed for 3.5x2 cards".

bleedIn.description: Bleed per side in inches. Default 0.125.

dpi.description: Resolution in dots per inch. Default 300.

tools.name: convert_paper_weight
tools.description: Converts a paper weight for 4OVER4 print stock between pounds text, pounds cover, gsm and points; use it when someone compares paper thickness across units. For paper recommendations use search_knowledge. Requires the numeric weight and its unit, one of lb-text, lb-cover, gsm or pt. Returns the weight in the other units. Customer phrases: "100lb cover in gsm", "is 14pt heavy", "what is 16pt in pounds", "how thick is 300 gsm card stock".

tools.name: get_print_file_setup
tools.description: Gives the artwork setup for a 4OVER4 print file: size, bleed, safe margin, 300 DPI, CMYK and file formats such as PDF; use it when someone asks how to set up a file for printing. For arithmetic at a custom size use calculate_print_bleed. The product slug is optional: with it the result uses that product's default size, without it the general setup. Customer phrases: "file requirements for business cards", "how do I set up my flyer file".

productSlug.description: Product slug, from the slug field of a show_products, recommend or find_similar_products result, e.g. standard-business-cards.

tools.name: daily_deals
tools.description: Shows today's 4OVER4 printing deal (product, discount, code and sale price); use it when someone asks for a print deal, discount or promo today. For discount policy use search_knowledge; for bulk savings use price_breaks. Takes no input. Returns the live deal, or the statement that none is live; deals rotate daily and stack with quantity discounts. Customer phrases: "any printing deals today", "do you have a promo code", "is there a discount on business cards".

tools.name: search_knowledge
tools.description: Answers printing and 4OVER4 support questions from 4OVER4's help center (bleed, file setup, paper, finishes, shipping, proofs, returns, custom quotes); use it for any how-to, policy or print term question. For one product's sizes or price use configure_product; for editorial pages use search_content. Requires the question as search words with the product or topic noun. Returns the answer, its source link and related questions. Customer phrases: "what is bleed", "my invitations arrived damaged", "are proofs free".

query.description: Search words for the question, with the product or topic noun, e.g. invitation misprint reprint refund.

topic.description: paper for a paper or stock recommendation, with the use case as query; free-business-cards for the 200 free business cards offer.

tools.name: search_content
tools.description: Finds 4OVER4 print guides, business print kits, product comparisons and case studies; use it when someone asks for a guide, a kit or a comparison page about printing. For support questions use search_knowledge; for products use show_products. Inputs are optional: query searches all the pages, types browses one kind, and slug with one type opens one item. Returns pages with links, or one page's detail. Customer phrases: "guides on file prep", "case studies for restaurants", "print kits for a new business".

types.description: Content types to search or browse.

slug.description: One item's slug, the last segment of its page address, sent with exactly one type in types.

tools.name: talk_to_human
tools.description: Gives the ways to reach 4OVER4's print support team (live chat, ticket, phone); use it when someone asks for a person or a custom print quote. For answers 4OVER4's help already holds use search_knowledge. The topic is optional and files nothing. Returns the support contact page link, where the customer starts a ticket or a live chat. Customer phrases: "can I talk to someone", "I need a custom quote for die-cut folders", "how do I contact support".

topic.description: Short summary of what the customer needs.

tools.name: get_my_orders
tools.description: Lists the signed-in customer's 4OVER4 print orders with their stage; use it when someone asks about their own orders. For one known order number use get_order_details. Inputs are optional: status and search narrow the list, insights adds totals. Returns order number, date, product, total and stage, newest first; with insights, spend and order totals. Needs the customer's 4OVER4 sign-in. Customer phrases: "what is my order status", "my postcard orders", "how much did I spend this year".

status.description: Stage filter, e.g. delivered, shipped, in production, cancelled.

insights.description: true adds order count, total spend, coins earned and top products.

tools.name: get_order_details
tools.description: Shows one 4OVER4 print order by its number: items, stage, tracking or invoice; use it when someone gives an order number or asks where their prints are. For a list of orders use get_my_orders. Requires the exact order or job number; view selects details, tracking or invoice. Returns the jobs, money, stage timeline, carrier link or invoice. Needs the customer's 4OVER4 sign-in. Customer phrases: "where is order 602074", "track my order", "send me the invoice for 602074".

jobId.description: The exact order or job number, e.g. 602074 or 602074-03.

tools.name: get_order_cancel_link
tools.description: Gives the link where a customer cancels their own 4OVER4 print order; use it when someone asks to cancel an order. This tool cancels nothing: the customer cancels a job that can still be cancelled on their 4OVER4 orders page, signed in there. To read an order's stage use get_order_details. The order or job number is optional and only names the order in the result. Returns the orders page link. Customer phrases: "cancel order 602074", "I changed my mind on my flyers".

jobId.description: The order or job number the customer wants to cancel, e.g. 602074.

tools.name: get_my_profile
tools.description: Shows the signed-in customer's 4OVER4 account: profile, saved addresses or QR codes; use it when someone asks about their own 4OVER4 account details. For orders use get_my_orders; for coins use get_my_coins. The section input is optional and defaults to profile. Returns name, email, phone, business and default addresses, every saved address, or saved QR codes. Needs the customer's 4OVER4 sign-in. Customer phrases: "show my profile", "what addresses do I have on file", "my saved QR codes".

tools.name: get_my_coins
tools.description: Shows the signed-in customer's 4OVER4 coins balance and history, the reward points earned on print orders; use it when someone asks about their coins. For ways to earn coins use loyalty_tasks; for redeeming rules use search_knowledge. Takes no input. Returns the balance and the earned and redeemed entries. Needs the customer's 4OVER4 sign-in. Customer phrases: "how many coins do I have", "my coin history", "what did I redeem last month", "my 4OVER4 rewards balance".

tools.name: get_cart
tools.description: Shows the signed-in customer's own 4OVER4 print cart; use it when someone asks what is in their cart. It only reads the cart; items are added on www.4over4.com product pages. For past orders use get_my_orders. Takes no input. Returns the cart lines with product, quantity and price, the total and the checkout link on www.4over4.com. Needs the customer's 4OVER4 sign-in. Customer phrases: "what is in my cart", "my cart total", "take me to checkout", "did my business cards stay in my cart".

tools.name: loyalty_tasks
tools.description: Lists the ways to earn 4OVER4 coins, the reward points spent on print orders; use it when someone asks how to earn coins or save on printing. For the customer's own balance use get_my_coins. The limit is optional and no sign-in is needed. Returns each task's title, short description, coins, time and page link; 100 coins are $1. Customer phrases: "how do I earn coins", "ways to get points", "what tasks give coins", "how can I save with rewards".

tools.name: create_checkout
tools.description: Starts a 4OVER4 checkout for print items, which the buyer finishes and pays on www.4over4.com; use it when the buyer is ready to order printing with UCP. UCP create_checkout (2026-04-08): a checkout session from line_items, or from a cart with cart_id. It is requires_escalation: 4OVER4 is paid only by the buyer: the continue_url adds the lines to the buyer's own 4OVER4 cart and opens www.4over4.com/checkout, where the buyer uploads artwork now or later, ships and pays.

profile.description: URL of the platform's UCP profile.

idempotency-key.description: Retry key; required by complete_checkout and cancel_checkout.

line_items.description: Full replacement. item.id is a catalog product id (its default configuration) or variant id (exactly that configuration, quantity tier included); quantity is how many such print jobs.
